name: Moodle AI Agent Stack
description: OpenClaw tool surface for the local Moodle local_aiagentapi stack.

manifestPath.description: Path to the Moodle command manifest. Relative paths are resolved from the plugin root.

maxSearchResults.description: Maximum results returned by moodle_catalog search.

repoRoot.description: Path to the Moodle repository root. Relative paths are resolved from the plugin root.

pythonBin.description: Python executable used to run scripts/moodle_cli.py.

cliPath.description: Path to the Moodle CLI script. Relative paths are resolved from repoRoot.

defaultWriteDryRun.description: Default write-capable Moodle tools to dry-run previews unless callers set dryRun=false and confirm=true.

allowDestructive.description: Allow destructive Moodle actions, currently forum delete, when callers also set dryRun=false and confirm=true.

enableApiTool.description: Enable moodle_api.call for manifest-listed local_aiagentapi functions.

allowApiWrites.description: Allow moodle_api.call to invoke write-capable manifest functions when normal write gates also pass.

allowedApiFunctions.description: Optional allowlist for moodle_api.call. When empty, only manifest functions with allowedByDefault=true can be called.
